meta.title: Submit a bid on a Tech+RFQ, commercial stage after the technical response
gaps: Verify that the commercial price is displayed next to a specific technical result in Master QCS; the catalog can read the price but not assert that exact adjacency or technical-result value.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the commercial price is displayed next to a specific technical result in Master QCS; the catalog can read the price but not assert that exact adjacency or technical-result value.

plan.title: Vendor submits commercial bid after technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its technical round as required for this prepared state.
Move to the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's technical round to establish that Vendor A reaches the event after the technical response.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the technical stage.
Open the commercial RFQ bid sheet after the technical stage.
Accept any required terms and submit the commercial quote of 100.
Verify that the vendor portal marks the RFQ bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the submitted commercial bid.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert that the submitted commercial price appears in Master QCS.
